AMF Client 2.0.1 Nova Edition — Windows x64 portable dependency manifest

Notice paths below are relative to the portable package root. This manifest
lists non-system DLLs present in the Windows x64 portable ZIP, plus statically
or object-linked third-party code for which the package also carries notices.

Third-party code linked into DDNet.exe (not a separately shipped DLL):
- GLEW (repository-bundled object library): licenses/third_party/GLEW-LICENSE.txt
- json-parser (repository-bundled object library):
  licenses/third_party/json-parser-LICENSE.txt
- ChaiScript (repository-bundled headers):
  licenses/third_party/ChaiScript-LICENSE.txt
- MD5 implementation (repository-bundled object library):
  licenses/third_party/md5-Aladdin-NOTICE.txt
- zlib compiled into the client: license.txt
- C++/WinRT headers used by the Windows media integration:
  licenses/third_party/cppwinrt-LICENSE

FFmpeg/x264 corresponding-source package (distribute alongside this portable):
AMF-Client-2.0.1-FFmpeg-x264-Corresponding-Source.zip
It contains FFmpeg 7.0.1 source, x264 commit
4613ac3c15fd75cebc4b9f65b7fb95e70a3acce1, the applicable upstream license
texts, source hashes, and build configuration/materials. See
licenses/third_party/FFmpeg-x264-BUILD-INFO.txt for the provenance and the
limits of the available toolchain record, and
licenses/third_party/FFmpeg-x264-SHA256SUMS.txt for source-archive hashes.

Provenance: these five DLLs are byte-identical to the Windows x64 files in
ddnet-libs commit d5f0cd9194936d1ab5bd19952645b8dffe9ae06c. Their embedded
configuration reports FFmpeg 7.0.1, --enable-gpl, and --enable-libx264. The
matching FFmpeg release source is n7.0.1 (commit
af25a4bfd2503caf3ee485b27b99b620302f5718). The x264 commit is reconstructed
from the dated x264-master source acquisition recorded by DDNet's dependency
build script and the upstream master history at the DLL build timestamp; it
is not embedded as a revision string in the DLLs. Bit-for-bit reproducibility
is not claimed because the original compiler/toolchain patch versions were
not recorded.
